qupath.ext.omero - package qupath.ext.omero
The OMERO extension enable accessing images hosted on an OMERO server.
qupath.ext.omero.core - package qupath.ext.omero.core
This package contains the core functionalities of the extension.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis
This package contains classes that perform requests to the different web APIs.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.commonentities - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.commonentities
This package contains entities used by several APIs.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.commonentities.shapes - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.commonentities.shapes
This package contains subclasses of Shape, which represents regions that can be drawn to an image.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.iviewer - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.iviewer
This package contains the IViewerApi, classes used internally, and objects used as parameters or return types of the API.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.iviewer.imageentities - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.iviewer.imageentities
Image entities returned by the OMERO iViewer API.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json
This package contains the JsonApi, classes used internally, and objects used as parameters or return types of the API.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities
This package contains OMERO entities returned by the JSON API.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.experimenters - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.experimenters
This package contains OMERO entities related to permissions: OmeroExperimenter represents an OMERO experimenter. OmeroExperimenterGroup represents an OMERO group.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.server - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.server
This package contains OMERO entities related the project/dataset/image and screen/plate/plate acquisition/well hierarchy.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.server.image - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.server.image
This package contains an OmeroImage and internal classes.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.shapes - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.jsonentities.shapes
This package contains OMERO shapes.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.permissions - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.permissions
This package contains classes that indicates who can access a particular OMERO entity.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.repositoryentities - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.repositoryentities
This package contains repository entities, which are elements belonging to the OMERO entity hierarchy.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.repositoryentities.serverentities - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.repositoryentities.serverentities

qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.serverinformation - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.json.serverinformation
This package contains serializable objects returned by requests that attempt to get information on a server.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient
This package contains the WebclientApi, classes used internally, and objects used as parameters or return types of the API.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.annotations - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.annotations
This package contains: Subclasses of Annotation, which represents metadata attached to OMERO entities. AnnotationCreator to create annotations from JSON. Classes used internally.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.annotations.omeroannotations - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.annotations.omeroannotations
This package contains records representing OMERO objects.
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.search - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.search

qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webgateway - package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webgateway
This package contains the WebGatewayApi, classes used internally, and objects used as parameters or return types of the API.

This package contains the image server and the image builder of this extension.
qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis - package qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis

qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis.mspixelbuffer - package qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis.mspixelbuffer

qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis.web - package qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis.web

qupath.ext.omero.core.preferences - package qupath.ext.omero.core.preferences
 
qupath.ext.omero.gui - package qupath.ext.omero.gui

This package contains menus and windows to browse an OMERO server.
qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser.advancedinformation - package qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser.advancedinformation

qupath.ext.omero.gui.connectionsmanager - package qupath.ext.omero.gui.connectionsmanager

qupath.ext.omero.gui.datatransporters - package qupath.ext.omero.gui.datatransporters

qupath.ext.omero.gui.datatransporters.forms - package qupath.ext.omero.gui.datatransporters.forms

qupath.ext.omero.gui.login - package qupath.ext.omero.gui.login
